text:
The fastest land animal in the world is the cheetah.

Based on your previous safari experience in Kenya and your desire for a destination that combines abundant wildlife with beach relaxation, as well as your partner's interest in bird watching, I recommend Zanzibar, Tanzania.

Zanzibar offers a perfect blend of your requirements. You can take a short flight or drive from mainland Tanzania to the Zanzibar Archipelago. The nearby Selous Game Reserve (Nyerere National Park) or the Ruaha National Park on the mainland offer incredible wildlife safaris, including the chance to see cheetahs, lions, and elephants. Zanzibar itself is renowned for its pristine white-sand beaches and turquoise waters, providing the relaxation you seek.

Furthermore, Zanzibar is a haven for bird watchers. The Jozani Chwaka Bay National Park is home to the rare Zanzibar red colobus monkey and over 200 species of birds, including the endemic Zanzibar red-billed starling. The mangrove forests and coastal areas offer excellent opportunities for observing a wide variety of bird species, satisfying your partner's interest while you enjoy the beach and wildlife.
